mapper.select: select s.s_deliveryname as sdeliveryname, s.s_name as sname, s.s_tel as stel, s.s_phone as sphone, s.s_addr as saddr,m.m_id as mid, s.s_no as sno from tea_shippingaddr s, tea_member m where s.m_no=m.m_no and m.m_id=#{m_id} order by m.m_no desc
mapper.insert: insert into tea_shippingaddr(s_no, s_deliveryname, s_name, s_zipno, s_addr, s_tel, s_phone, s_defaddr, m_no) values(tea_shippingaddr_seq.NEXTVAL, #{s_deliveryname}, #{s_name}, #{s_zipno}, #{s_addr}, #{s_tel}, #{s_phone}, #{s_defaddr}, #{m_no})
